commitResults.messageBody: Move command input, startup and farewell presentation, separators, and formatted messages out of Charlie so the main class can focus more clearly on application control. Preserve all existing user-visible behavior and add an exact startup greeting case to guard the extraction against regressions.

Move the save path, file reading and writing, and saved-task reconstruction out of Charlie. Keep missing files as an empty first-time-user state and add a UI regression case that protects this behavior.

Move command recognition, date and task-index validation, and task creation parsing out of Charlie. Keep Ui limited to input and output, preserve all command messages, and add coverage for events missing their required delimiters.

Move task ownership, indexed access, add and remove operations, size tracking, persistence snapshots, and date filtering out of Charlie. Eliminate the separate task counter and add regression coverage for an out-of-range deletion.

Convert Charlie from static application state into an object that owns Ui, Storage, and TaskList collaborators. Let run coordinate loading and command processing, remove Ui parameters, retain safe empty-list fallback after loading failures, and strengthen the startup regression case to prove the application remains usable.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align MoreOOP classes with Java coding standard
commitResults.messageBody: Use clearer verb-based method names and update public API Javadocs with American spelling, capitalization, and punctuation required by the SE-EDU intermediate Java conventions. Preserve all existing behavior and keep the broader package migration out of this scoped style change.

Let TaskList own mark, unmark, and delete operations and return the affected task to Charlie for persistence and presentation. Add a regression case proving that an invalid deletion leaves the task collection unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Apply Java coding standard across project
commitResults.messageBody: Move every source into the lowercase charlie package and matching directory, update compile and run instructions, document previously undocumented public APIs, use American spelling, add explicit switch fallthrough comments, and clarify method, variable, and related-constant names. Preserve all existing chatbot behavior.

Rename the existing command enum to CommandType so the Command name is available for the stretch-goal abstract base class. Update parser and coordination references without changing console behavior. Add a leading-whitespace command regression case and verify the complete UI plan on Java 25.

Add the Command execution contract and default non-exit behavior as the base for concrete command classes. Add a repeat-list regression case first to ensure future ListCommand extraction remains read-only. Verify all 44 UI cases on Java 25.

Extract the task-list display workflow into a concrete Command implementation while leaving the existing Charlie dispatch unchanged. This isolates the behavior for review before integration and preserves the tested read-only list semantics. Verify all 44 UI cases on Java 25.

Route the LIST branch through the concrete command object and remove Charlie's duplicate list-display method. This begins moving command-specific workflows out of the application coordinator while preserving the existing parser bridge and console behavior. Verify all 44 UI cases on Java 25.

Add a concrete exit command that owns farewell output and reports its exit status through the shared Command contract. Route the BYE branch through the command object and add a standalone termination regression case before implementation. Verify all 45 UI cases on Java 25.

Add a concrete command that marks the selected task, persists the updated list, and displays the confirmation. Route the MARK branch through it, remove Charlie's duplicate workflow, and add a post-mark list regression case before implementation. Verify all 46 UI cases on Java 25.

Add a concrete command that marks the selected task as not done, persists the updated list, and displays the confirmation. Route the UNMARK branch through it, remove Charlie's duplicate workflow, and add a post-unmark list regression case before implementation. Verify all 47 UI cases on Java 25.

Add a concrete command that removes the selected task, persists the reduced list, and displays the result. Route the DELETE branch through it, remove Charlie's duplicate workflow, and add a repeated-delete regression case before implementation. Verify all 48 UI cases on Java 25.
